en.image_alt: Watch our partner's illustrated video interview!
en.body:
Discover the great work of Christof BUCHER, Professor of Photovoltaic Systems at the Photovoltaic Laboratory (PV Lab) of the Bern University of Applied Sciences (BFH). His work mainly focuses on testing PV systems that cannot be tested by the private industry. [\-> Watch the full video in English here](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Mk4VqEdDZCc)

This video is also available in -> [German here](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hgwTBxx3oGg)
